method.purpose: Compare sensitivity and lag with fixed A65, not optimize the highest in-sample return.
method.warmup: Compare only dates with at least ten valid distinct valuation records already available by each archived record date.
method.input: Only past/current records; each proxy uses the current valuation close and current bond yield. Future observations used solely for outcome evaluation.
method.baseline: Same record-date-next-session-close entry, common Excel cutoff; only price-index returns, no cash portfolio or dividend reinvestment.
method.proxy: Yield times index level is a diagnostic proxy, not aggregate actual cash dividends. Smoothed yields are modelling inputs, never corrected official data.
method.limitations: One conspicuous month-end discontinuity in a short, retrospectively completed data set; overlapping outcomes, not point-in-time or out-of-sample proof.

realPriceDropAtConstantBase.condition: Hypothetical constant dividend-base proxy and bond yield; illustrates different price response, not an actual market observation.

review.rationale: Smaller month-end score discontinuity while preserving same-day price response; selection based on mechanism, not the largest observed mean return.
review.productionDecision: Not applied. First use as a separately labelled shadow score. A real dividend reduction must not be treated as a correctable data error; causal smoothing delays its recognition.
review.displayContract: Preserve and display original published yield and raw rating; label effective yield as a smoothed modelling reference, not official yield.
review.dataQualityCandidate: Flag abs(change in yield-times-price proxy) >= 5% for review; threshold is a provisional diagnostic, not calibrated evidence and not an automatic correction.
review.insufficientEvidence: Only one observed >=5% dividend-base-proxy discontinuity; cannot establish a globally optimal window or future trading benefit.

chineseSummary.candidate: 5期分红参考基数均值，再按当日指数点位换算评分参考股息率；仅作为独立标注的观察评分候选，未应用。
steps: 参考基数 = 当日原始股息率 × 同日指数收盘点位
取最近5条当时已可得有效记录的参考基数均值
评分参考股息率 = 均值 ÷ 当日指数收盘点位；股债倍数使用该参考值与当日国债收益率
chineseSummary.preserved: 原始股息率、原始评级、92/8权重、原锚点、C40/B48/A65分界及仅A级可买入规则均保留。
chineseSummary.limitation: 参考基数不是实际分红总额。真实分红减少也会被平滑，压力情景中前两期仍为A、第三期降为B；仅有一次明显月末跳变，无法证明最优或可替代原始评级。
chineseSummary.sample: 共同有效比较从2026-06-17开始，共74条已完成收益信号；回测统一截止日仍为2026-10-15。所有统计为重叠信号后指数收益，不是资金收益。
